_about: T.O. 1C-131B-2-2 page 2B's front view: the scan's crop 100,1990,1700,2408 saved at 72 dpi, then layers.py --mode image --threshold 170 at scale 3.0214 (the side's scale: its tips 4492 px apart at scale 3, against the printed 105 ft 4 in). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the left half. The wing tip is placed at the plan's (96 px: the front view draws the fuselage 0.11 m right of the middle between its tips). The C-131B's propeller disc and nacelle hide the wing between 1450 and 2000 (bridged, both lines); the tailplane shows only between the disc and the fuselage.
